title: microfixlet-orch-lite-and-telemetry-wrangler
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a lightweight orchestrator (MicroFixlet Orchestrator Lite) that converts canonical runbook steps into parameterized, idempotent microfixlets. These microfixlets should be callable from the admin console and CLI, support dry-run semantics, attach rich telemetry for observability, and enforce permissioned safety rails. The goal is to accelerate first-line support escalations with one-click remediation while preserving auditability and rollback capability.
acceptance_criteria: Add a microfixlet registry UI in the Console that lists microfixlets with metadata (owner, inputs, required scopes, dry-run supported)
Runtime: support execution with dry-run, simulate, and commit modes; dry-run must not modify state and must return a concise delta plan
Telemetry: every invocation must emit structured telemetry (invocation id, inputs hash, runtime cost estimate, success/failure, affected resources) to Ops metrics and traces
Safety: permission gating (RBAC) and a two-step approval flow for high-impact fixlets; system must log approver and justification
Idempotency: microfixlets must include a safe-check step to avoid repeated side-effects; tests to demonstrate idempotent behavior
Developer DX: provide a template and CLI tool to author microfixlets from existing runbook fragments (YAML -> microfixlet)
